features.name: Canny Defense
features.summary: While lightly armored or unarmored, unshielded, and wielding a melee weapon, add up to one point of Intelligence bonus per Duelist level as a dodge bonus to AC.

features.name: Precise Strike
features.summary: Add Duelist level to damage with a light or one-handed piercing weapon when the other hand is not attacking or using a shield.

features.name: Improved Reaction +2
features.summary: Gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks.

features.name: Parry
features.summary: Forego a full-attack strike to contest and potentially negate an attack against you or an adjacent ally.

features.name: Enhanced Mobility
features.summary: Gain +4 AC against attacks of opportunity caused by moving from a threatened square while lightly armored or unarmored and unshielded.

features.name: Combat Reflexes
features.summary: Gain the benefit of Combat Reflexes while using a light or one-handed piercing weapon.

features.name: Grace
features.summary: Gain +2 on Reflex saves while lightly armored or unarmored and unshielded.

features.name: Riposte
features.summary: Make an attack of opportunity against a creature whose attack you successfully parry.

features.name: Acrobatic Charge
features.summary: Charge across difficult terrain and through other conditions that normally prevent charging.

features.name: Elaborate Defense
features.summary: While fighting defensively or using total defense in melee, gain +1 dodge AC per three Duelist levels.

features.name: Deflect Arrows
features.summary: Gain the benefit of Deflect Arrows with a light or one-handed piercing weapon without needing a free hand.

features.name: No Retreat
features.summary: Adjacent enemies provoke an attack of opportunity when they withdraw.

features.name: Crippling Critical
features.summary: A confirmed critical hit with a light or one-handed piercing weapon can also slow, damage an ability, penalize saves or AC, or cause bleed.
